analyzed_vuln.description: The root cause is missing validation of the result of serialization in SingleSubstFormat2_4::subset(). It computes an iterator of remapped glyph pairs and then calls SingleSubst_serialize(c->serializer, it) but ignores the returned bool. When malformed GSUB/Coverage data drives inconsistent or unsafe iterator/serialization state, the serializer can fail or write through invalid state; because the failure is ignored, execution continues into a wild write that manifests in IntType::operator= (hb-open-type.hh:65) during CoverageFormat2 serialization.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Trigger requires a crafted font processed by hb-subset-fuzzer that reaches GSUB SingleSubst format 2 subtable subsetting (via hb_subset_or_fail -> GSUB lookup subset -> SingleSubstFormat2_4::subset). The input must produce problematic coverage/substitute mapping during iterator-based serialization so that SingleSubst_serialize fails/enters invalid serializer state; since subset() does not check/propagate that return value, subsequent field assignments write to an invalid address, causing the ASan SEGV write.
